info.title: Sebela API
info.description: The content API of sebelapetr.cz. Reads are public; every write needs an API key, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` and never in the URL. Every route is rate limited and answers failures with the common error shape. `GET /health` reports liveness only.

get.description: Answers while the process runs; it does not check the database. Its own budget.

400.description: `credentials_in_url` (a credential was sent in the query string)

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is renewed.

get.description: Answers whether the API can serve content now: it checks that the database answers within a short time. For uptime monitoring and the website's health check; never cached. Shares the health budget.

200.description: The API and its database answer.

400.description: `credentials_in_url` (a credential was sent in the query string)

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is renewed.

503.description: `unavailable`: the database cannot be reached now, without details.

get.description: Answers whether the presented API key is valid now, with the same verification and budgets as every private route. It reads and changes no content and reveals nothing about the key. A server-side caller that acts for the key holder, such as MCP Admin, checks it before every operation, so a revoked key stops working on its next one.

400.description: `credentials_in_url` (a credential was sent in the query string)

401.description: `unauthorized`: the API key is missing, malformed, unknown or revoked.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is renewed.

400.description: `credentials_in_url` (a credential was sent in the query string)

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is renewed.

post.description: There is at most one person; a second create is a conflict. `photoId` attaches uploaded image media and `cvPdfId` an uploaded, manually prepared PDF; the wrong kind or unknown media is refused.
